hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/memory-retire-session.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python "$f"
command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 timeout 10 code-review-graph enrich 2>/dev/null || true
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/block-content-through-shell.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python "$f"
